name: Animal Antics
source:
A snail, a bird, and a cat walk into a meteor. And a cavern of shadows. And a secret laboratory. What kinds of crazy antics are these animals getting themselves into?

[From [url=https://bejules.itch.io/animal-antics]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一只蜗牛、一只鸟和一只猫，闯进了一颗陨石。还有一座阴影洞穴，以及一间秘密实验室。这些动物究竟在折腾些什么疯狂的事？

[摘自[url=https://bejules.itch.io/animal-antics]itch.io[/url]]
